A stronger isomorphism route seeks block-row signs u_a and block-column signs v_b in{+1,-1}. Reflect every local row coordinate throughout block row a by u_a and every local column coordinate throughout block column b by v_b. These ARE global row and column permutations and preserve all rectangles. Substituting r=u_a*r', c=v_b*c' gives, after absorbing v_b into the word, new sign e'_ab=e_ab*u_a*v_b. Necessity is the two-column rectangle; sufficiency recovers any rectangle from its two rows.
